title: test_terminal_class_profiles measures profile + surge: the '>10x home' ratio passes only because the era-3 streaming_surge set-piece is active inside the test window
evidence: core/demand_test.odin:405 '// One terminal per role (the weighted pick is then deterministic — the pick's rng draw picks the only candidate), so the per-role counts are the profile.' ; :429 'W :: u64(2000)' ; :437 'for tick in u64(1)..=W {' ; :478 'testing.expectf(t, per_role[3] > 10*per_role[0], "campus >> home in volume: campus %d vs residential %d (want > 10x)", per_role[3], per_role[0])' ; core/determinism_test.odin:129 'append(&e.set_pieces, Set_Piece{id = "streaming_surge", class = 1, multiplier = 10, start_tick = 1200, duration_ticks = 1800, forecast_lead_ticks = 600, archetype_idx = 0})'
detail: The surge set-piece (start_tick 1200) is live for ticks 1200-2000 of the W=2000 window. Running the exact scenario: campus=3202, home=306, so 10x clears only under surge credit-saturation; the honest base ratio is ~6.5x. The comment claims counts equal the profile; they are profile+surge.
recommended_fix: Disable set-pieces in test_terminal_class_profiles (or measure only pre-surge ticks) so per-role counts are the base profile, and assert the honest ratio instead of the surge-inflated 10x.

title: role_from_name resolution for 'small_biz'/'campus' has no unit-level test — only the self-blessed harness goldens exercise the JSON→enum path
evidence: core/catalog.odin:1045 'case "small_biz":   return .Small_Biz' ; :1046 'case "campus":      return .Campus' ; core/catalog_test.odin:27-31 NT_VALID rows end at router_high (no small_biz/campus rows; suite is rejection-only, e.g. :137 'cerr := catalogs_load(cat, &src)')
detail: catalog_test is rejection-only and its valid baselines omit the new types; test_catalog appends Node_Type directly (bypassing role_from_name). A broken mapping would silently load role .None and bless green goldens. The T1 fold hash and T2 pixels cannot distinguish correct resolution from a self-consistent wrong one.
recommended_fix: Extend NT_VALID with small_biz/campus rows and add a positive-load test asserting parsed terminal_role == .Small_Biz/.Campus, or add a direct role_from_name unit test for the two new names.

title: E9.1 sprite mapping (role→indices 9/10) has no positive assertion — the all-three-types T2 golden is a self-blessed pixel-compare
evidence: app/render/sprites.odin:141 'case .Small_Biz:    return 9' ; :142 'case .Campus:       return 10' ; app/render contains no @(test) files (only app/audio/audio_test.odin exists in app/)
detail: The harness pins T2 pixels against blessed PNGs and T1 replay hashes only; no test asserts the role→index mapping or distinctness from house/host (4 and id%4). A wrong mapping (e.g. campus→house) would be blessed and stay green, so the card's 'distinct shapes' assertion is not machine-checked.
recommended_fix: Add a small unit test asserting sprite_index_building(.Small_Biz)==9, .Campus==10, and distinctness from Content_Host/house indices, pinning E9.1 independent of golden blessing.
